newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala newborn dies after rescue from toilet.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala newborn dies after rescue from toilet.

text.p: A baby rescued by firemen after she was accidentally born into a pit toilet died late on Tuesday, El Grafico newspaper reported on Wednesday.

According to the report, 26-year-old Nelvia Diaz knew she was in labour but did not realise how close she was to giving birth when she went to the bathroom and sat on the toilet on Tuesday, only to feel the baby girl slide out and fall into the pit beneath her.
Firemen used tubes to supply oxygen to the baby while they spent four hours tearing down the outhouse and destroying the concrete slab covering the human waste pit.
The baby was alive when she was taken to a local hospital but the newspaper said she died hours later.
